{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:47.980

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:51.899
    | text      = this, but that's fair enough.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:56.340
    | text      = I find myself thrown by how disconnected everything really seems in terms of the first seven installments
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:03.879
    | text      = of this series.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:05.980
    | text      = And then Bill starts off here and I found myself once again suffering from whiplash.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:12.220
    | text      = From Tinkerbell to Artie Shaw to George Bush's Thousand Points of Light, America has been
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:18.419
    | text      = mesmerized by stardust since its very inception.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:23.659
    | text      = And now America is beginning to learn what all these references to the star, the morning
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:28.379
    | text      = star, wish upon a star, stardust, really is all about.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:35.299
    | text      = There was something very strange about the classical mysteries, something which attracted
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:41.940
    | text      = people to them and having attracted them, made their initiates with very few exceptions
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:47.620
    | text      = permanent devotees.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:50.259
    | text      = In Egypt, Greece, India, Rome, and a dozen other places and countries, sacred initiations
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.700
    | text      = took place in specially prepared sanctuaries, usually in a cave or underground.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:02.519
    | text      = So that opening about Tinkerbell and what have you, I was like, this doesn't match tonally
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:07.179
    | text      = with the stuff you're clearly reading.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:09.539
    | text      = Yeah, what are we reading now?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:10.539
    | text      = There's gotta be a point where we jumped from Bill saying something about Tinkerbell and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:16.659
    | text      = Shaw and the Thousand Points of Light.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:20.100
    | text      = That's him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:21.100
    | text      = And then he jumps to text.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:23.620
    | text      = So that's just him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:24.620
    | text      = The rest of it is just him reading from a book called A History of Secret Societies
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:28.100
    | text      = by someone named Arkhan Darul.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:32.299
    | text      = This was a pen name that was used by a man named Ibarias Shaw, who was a proponent of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:37.500
    | text      = Sufism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:38.500
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:39.539
    | text      = Sufism is generally associated with Islam, but Shaw's particular take on the belief was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:43.299
    | text      = that it's applicable across religions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:46.059
    | text      = There's a universal wisdom in his form of Sufism that could benefit everyone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:51.139
    | text      = Shaw wrote a whole lot, including a book from 1964 called The Sufis, which is largely credited
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:56.259
    | text      = with bringing Sufi mysticism to a Western audience.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:59.860
    | text      = That was a pretty impactful release, but a couple years prior, he'd released two less
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:03.820
    | text      = successful books under his alias Arkhan Darul, which one of them was this book, The History
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:09.480
    | text      = of Secret Societies, and the other was titled Witches and Sorcerers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:13.960
    | text      = Ooh!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:14.960
    | text      = We're close.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:15.960
    | text      = No!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:16.960
    | text      = God dammit!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:17.960
    | text      = So Bill is just stealing the text of this book, but he's also depriving the audience
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:21.399
    | text      = from understanding the perspective of the person who wrote the original words.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:26.679
    | text      = This is a text written by an influential Sufi thinker who's published this book on secret
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:31.320
    | text      = societies under a pen name, which is worth thinking about why.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:36.159
    | text      = Why would that be?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:37.159
    | text      = Why wouldn't he put his own name on this?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:39.200
    | text      = Why would there be?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:41.600
    | text      = That context is missing.
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:05.819
    | text      = I think one of the downsides and one of the difficulties of plagiarism is you're beholden
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:09.539
    | text      = to the texts and paragraphs of the person you're plagiarizing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:14.779
    | text      = And so episode one can't lead into episode two or three or four or five.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:20.140
    | text      = He's just reading these things and demanding that they be connected and they're not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:25.740
    | text      = He hasn't done the work of connecting any of this stuff to make it a palatable and worthwhile
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:31.819
    | text      = exercise in communication.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:33.740
    | text      = And that's infuriating.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:34.740
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:35.740
    | text      = I mean, it reminds me when I was reading way early on, the only teacher that I liked was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:43.579
    | text      = like just explaining like, hey, keep notes, keep notes in the margins of your books, keep
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:48.420
    | text      = notes to show where it is that you think this is doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:52.059
    | text      = And then you can refer back to it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:53.940
    | text      = And it's like, that's not supposed to be me reading the book and then adding my little
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:00.859
    | text      = notes in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:01.859
    | text      = That's not how audio books should work.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:03.380
    | text      = No, no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:04.380
    | text      = Like I'm not going to like, I'm reading Harry Potter and then being like, and also Cho Chang
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:09.180
    | text      = is kind of a racist name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:10.420
    | text      = Let's face it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:11.420
    | text      = I mean, it's a little bit of a racist name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:12.420
    | text      = Anyways, Harry Potter was then doing that, you know, that's neither an audio book nor
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:16.900
    | text      = is it a worthwhile product of analysis that you're doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:23.779
    | text      = It fails on both counts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:25.819
    | text      = And that's what's going on with Bill.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:28.259
    | text      = So one of the reasons I went back to cover these Mystery Babylon episodes were because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:32.339
    | text      = I said that we were going to do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:34.660
    | text      = And I feel like what I want to do is make good on some of these old ideas.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:39.819
    | text      = Like finally getting around to these things that seemed like a decent plan, but we never
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:44.000
    | text      = put them into motion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:45.819
    | text      = But I find this content to be intolerable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:49.140
    | text      = I can't handle this shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:51.579
    | text      = There's an ethical aspect to it where Bill is just reading other people's books and trying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:55.140
    | text      = to obscure that fact and present this content as being his own creation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:59.720
    | text      = But there's another aspect to this that's just boring.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:03.220
    | text      = It doesn't build to a larger point.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:05.460
    | text      = These are just disconnected chapters from random books Bill's reading and pretending
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:09.579
    | text      = that in the process he's risking his life to uncover a mystery religion that secretly
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:14.059
    | text      = runs the world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:15.779
    | text      = If Bill were making a compelling argument and any of this made sense, I might be able
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:19.819
    | text      = to tough it out and make it through the rest of these episodes, but this is just shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:24.619
    | text      = There is no reason to take this seriously and the existence of this series is an indictment
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:28.940
    | text      = of Bill Cooper's legacy and embarrassing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:32.000
    | text      = It should be the end of his legacy, honestly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:34.420
    | text      = Quite frankly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:35.420
    | text      = It's the end of my concern with it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:37.099
    | text      = Yeah, it really, this really should, like, if anybody brings up Bill Cooper, you should
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:42.700
    | text      = listen to this and then you'll be like, oh, aw.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:46.220
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:47.220
    | text      = Even still, I could maybe have kept going if I thought that we were eventually going
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:51.019
    | text      = to get to witches, but I made a classic mistake of looking at the titles of the upcoming episodes
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:56.460
    | text      = and there's no witches to be found.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:58.619
    | text      = I think eventually Bill starts breaking down some of the eventual plot of the Assassin's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:02.440
    | text      = Creed games, but looking over the list of what's to come, I'm cutting bait.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:07.420
    | text      = I made it to episode eight and honestly, that's way too far for anyone who approaches this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:11.559
    | text      = with a critical eye.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:13.019
    | text      = I'm closing the door on Mystery Babylon and we can consider this item on the checklist
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:18.660
    | text      = checked the fuck off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:20.420
    | text      = However, before I leave this behind entirely, I wanted to point out that episode 17 of this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I'm sorry?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:33.339
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:34.339
    | text      = Well, it's worse than you think.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:35.339
    | text      = I believe that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:36.339
    | text      = I saw that title and I thought, well, here's where Bill's going to cop to the fact that

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = he's been reading for the previous 16 episodes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:47.180
    | text      = That's what a bibliography of this might look like.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:50.559
    | text      = I thought it was good, but it's not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:53.779
    | text      = The episode is reading off basically a reading list that's supposed to make Bill look smarter.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:00.720
    | text      = The sources that we've seen him pull from so far have been pretty low level in terms

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Chris Gaines is one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:09.579
    | text      = Here's a little snippet of Bill's Mystery Babylon bibliography.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:14.480
    | text      = Most people though sit back and say, I don't know where to find it.

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:24.160
    | text      = That's the way to do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:25.160
    | text      = The second book I'm going to recommend here that you get is a book by Joseph Campbell,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Again, it's by Joseph Campbell, Primitive Mythology, the Masks of God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:48.480
    | text      = And I believe it's printed by Penguin Books.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:52.000
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:53.000

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:02.119
    | text      = Also published by Penguin Books.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:07.119

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = the most important for you to use to get started with and working on that.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:29:57.880

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:01.440
    | text      = like that, but I am going to say that he did not read out of those books.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:33.079
    | text      = if he did read Joseph Campbell, Joseph Campbell would have hit him with a book.

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:30:37.720
    | text      = Like this is...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:38.720
    | text      = He is not doing good storytelling in terms of this series.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:30:43.240

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
